reason: The conclusion 'stay closed for 29 Sep' is right, but that was already the state, so the finding adds no action. Its real content is the curator rewrite 'lab-precision premise broken', and that claim is overstated. (1) The cap-6 lab read was blind, not wrong. It had 0 TP / 4 FP / 81 unannotated, i.e. 4 evaluable forks. Probe 45 (+0.001..+0.003 display, about 1-2 net public TPs) says the lab could not see that increment. It does not show that well-measured lab precisions mis-transfer. The closed add families were priced on large evaluable pools: I-047/I-078-type orphan attach 7 TP / +200 evaluable FP (3.4%) and 17 TP / +698 FP (2.4%) on exp60; I-076 precision 4-15%; I-078 0.19. These are 2-10x below the 0.265 bar. One n~2 read on a LEARNED ranker (DaughterNet v1 at cap 6) cannot lift geometric, edge or image rules by that factor. (2) 'Public embryo division-easier' is not new. J_pub ~0.36 (probe 26, 24 Sep 02:00Z) is the input that DEFINED the 0.265 break-even the old verdicts used (CONTEXT l.1318-1322), and I-077's '~0.5 TP vs ~1.5 FP' was already a public-transfer estimate (FINAL_REPORT v3 l.411). (3) DC 0.30 is a fork-REMOVAL knob. R2-RC-B already noted that public reads treat removals asymmetrically, so it says little about add precision. (4) There is zero evidence about private (71%, other embryos). A public-embryo shift does not support 'lab does not predict private precision'. (5) Reason (a) 'new code after R8' is stale: the user lifted R8 for public division-side rungs (27 Sep 11:14/11:16Z, CONTEXT l.2940-2960). The binding reasons are feasibility ones: no code or dummy for I-076/077/078; v2 weights not local (weights_dataset/vitalii_daughternet = v1 fold_0..4.pt only; data_external/l2/kds_v2_out holds scores/logs, no .pt); v2 needs an ensemble re-calibration (OOF 0.5 ~ ensemble 0.4); ~7.5 h latency; and the slots go to measured dose rungs (exp78a/78b). Only for I-063 (v2 ranker, same insertion path, higher pool AUC 0.875 vs 0.825) is the 'marginal-rank matters more at high cap' argument coherent. It stays a post-deadline item, and v2 already read WORSE than v1 on SELECTION (noise-level, R14-RC-B).
fix: Do NOT rewrite I-076/I-077/I-078 as 'premise broken'. Keep their refutations (evaluable-pool precision 2-19% vs 0.265, already public-calibrated), and add one line: 'probe 45 shows that the exp60 lab is blind (not mis-signed) for small marginal add sets; it does not re-price these large-pool precisions'. Replace the 'R8' reason with 'no code/dummy/gate; user-lifted R8 does not help; slots go to dose rungs'. For I-063 only: add the note 'v2 ranker at high cap is the first post-deadline item; gate it on per-embryo added-fork precision on public-like data (late submissions), not on the exp60 lab; load v2 .pt from the kdn-train output'. No build, no slot, no user question.
realistic_gain: 0 on the 29 Sep outcome (no action, no slot). Post-deadline: learning value only, and only for I-063. I-076/077/078 have no credible path to 0.265 precision.
